subject_id.notes: Individual codes such as M01.1, M02.3, etc. appear in figures/legends, but a complete per-subject ID list is only in Supplementary Table 1, not provided in the given text.

pmid.notes: PMID not explicitly stated in the provided text; the externally supplied paper_id (27723761) likely corresponds to the PMID but this was not confirmed in-text.

target_condition.evidence_quote: samples from four families with multiple cases of type 1 diabetes mellitus (T1DM)

control.evidence_quote: No differences in taxonomic or functional diversity and richness were observed between individuals with T1DM and their healthy relatives
control.notes: Study explicitly compares individuals with T1DM (cases) to healthy family members (controls); no single study-level value applies.

country.evidence_quote: existing patient cohorts from the Centre Hospitalier du Luxembourg
country.section: Methods — Anthropometric, nutritional, clinical data and blood and stool sampling
country.notes: Country inferred from institution name and author affiliations, not an explicit 'country' statement.

body_site.evidence_quote: well-preserved faecal samples collected over a period of two to four months
body_site.section: Results — Study cohort and microbial community structures

days_from_first_collection.evidence_quote: Recruited families were seen three times at intervals of between four and eight weeks to have data and samples collected
days_from_first_collection.section: Methods — Anthropometric, nutritional, clinical data and blood and stool sampling
days_from_first_collection.notes: Only visit interval range (4-8 weeks) given; no exact per-sample days-from-first-collection reported.

westernized.evidence_quote: existing patient cohorts from the Centre Hospitalier du Luxembourg
westernized.section: Methods — Anthropometric, nutritional, clinical data and blood and stool sampling
westernized.notes: Not explicitly labeled 'westernized'; inferred from Luxembourg (European) cohort location.

dna_extraction_kit.evidence_quote: extraction using the All-In-One kit (Norgen Biotek) to recover DNA and proteins were carried out as previously described
dna_extraction_kit.section: Methods — Extraction of biomolecular fractions from faecal samples
dna_extraction_kit.notes: MOBIO Power Soil Kit was also used to supplement DNA fractions and MOBIO PowerMicrobiome RNA Isolation Kit for RNA; multiple kits used, Norgen Biotek reported as primary DNA/protein extraction kit.

ncbi_accession.evidence_quote: Metagenomic and metatranscriptomic sequencing reads can be accessed from NCBI BioProject PRJNA289586

sequencing_platform.evidence_quote: DNA was sequenced with 101 bp (per paired end) on a HiSeq2000 system (Illumina) by BGI
sequencing_platform.section: Methods — Metagenomic DNA and RNA sequencing
sequencing_platform.notes: Metatranscriptomic cDNA libraries were sequenced on an Illumina HiSeq2500; both instruments map to IlluminaHiSeq.

age.notes: Detailed age data referenced only in Supplementary Table 1, not included in provided text.

age_group.evidence_quote: four families of at least two generations presenting at least two cases of T1DM
age_group.section: Results — Study cohort and microbial community structures
age_group.notes: Cohort spans at least two generations implying both adult and possibly younger members, but no explicit age-group breakdown is given in the main text.

family.evidence_quote: The study cohort consisted of 20 individuals from four families of at least two generations

family.notes: Four families (labeled M1/M01–M4/M04 in figures) are described, but per-subject family assignment is not tabulated in the provided text (see Fig. 1a pedigrees, Supplementary Table 1).

family_role.notes: Pedigree figure (Fig. 1a) shows generational structure but explicit mother/father/child role labels per individual are not in the extracted text.

sex.evidence_quote: Female with T1DM Male with T1DM Female without T1DM Male without T1DM

extraction_warnings: This paper primarily reports group-level aggregate statistics (mean ± s.d.) and qualitative comparisons between T1DM cases and healthy relatives; per-subject/per-sample metadata (age, sex, exact family assignment, sample IDs) are referenced as being in Supplementary Tables 1-3, which were not included in the provided text, so many fields are marked not_reported.

Granularity was set to subgroup_level using T1DM vs Healthy as the primary axis since the paper explicitly stratifies most analyses by T1DM status (and secondarily by family), but comprehensive per-subgroup demographic data were not available in the provided text.

Multiple DNA/RNA extraction kits were used (Norgen Biotek All-In-One kit, MOBIO PowerSoil Kit, MOBIO PowerMicrobiome RNA Isolation Kit); only the primary DNA/protein kit (Norgen Biotek) was reported for the dna_extraction_kit field.
PMID was not explicitly stated within the provided paper text; the externally supplied paper_id (27723761) may correspond to the PMID but was not verified from in-text evidence.

This paper is a microbiome multi-omics study of familial type 1 diabetes; many schema fields (tumor staging, disease response, FMT, neonatal, obstetric/gynecologic, HLA typing, smoking, antibiotics) are not applicable or not reported in the main text and were marked not_reported.
Detailed demographic/clinical data (ages, BMI, diet specifics) are stated to be in Supplementary Table 1, which was not provided in the given text, so numeric values could not be extracted.

Granularity was set to subgroup_level (T1DM vs Healthy) because disease and treatment status differ systematically between these two groups within families, though exact per-individual values are not given in main text.
Batch 2 returned granularity='study_level', differs from batch 0 ('subgroup_level'); kept batch 0.
Batch 2 subgroups [] differ from batch 0 ['T1DM', 'Healthy']; kept batch 0.

This paper is a gut microbiome multi-omics study, not an oncology/clinical trial paper; most schema fields (disease_response_os, ecog_performance_status, tumor_size fields) are not applicable and were marked not_reported.

Biomarker values for pancreatic/immune proteins (AMY2A, AMY2B, CPA1, CUZD1, LTF, ITLN1) are only presented graphically (boxplots) without explicit numeric values in the main text, so biomarker_value could not be extracted quantitatively.
feces_phenotype_value field does not clearly map to any explicit reported phenotype metric in this paper; treated as not_reported.
